patterns.message: common/ is the feature-agnostic leaf layer: it must not import from features/. Promote what both need into common/, or move this module up a layer.
common/ is the feature-agnostic leaf layer: it must not import from store/ (store already imports common/, so this would be a cycle). A store-connected module belongs in store/, features/, or app/.
common/ must not import from app/. app/ is the composition root and sits above every other layer.
store/ may depend only on common/. Promote shared vocabulary into common/ or store/lib/ instead of reaching into a feature.
store/ must not import from app/. app/ is the composition root and sits above every other layer.
features/account must not import a sibling feature. Promote what both need into common/ (pure or presentational) or store/ (state-shaped), or let app/ compose them.
A feature must not import from app/. app/ composes features, never the other way round.

app/ may import a feature only through its barrel: use '@/features/<area>'. If what you need is not exported there, add it to that feature's index.ts (or give it a proper entry point) rather than reaching into the feature's internals.
